v22-19.candidate: because your heart was softened and you felt shame before the Lord when you heard what I spoke against this place and its inhabitants, that they should become an obliteration and a curse, and because you tore your garments and wept before Me, I also have heard, says the Lord.
v22-19.close: because your heart was softened and you did feel shame before the Lord when you heard what I spoke against this place and its inhabitants, that they should become an obliteration and a curse, and because you did rend your garments and did weep before Me, I also have heard, says the Lord.
